notebooks.title: 复算延迟路径与停车预算
notebooks.setupCode:
import math
def budget(v, delay, b, d, margin=2.0):
    reaction = v * delay
    braking = v ** 2 / (2 * b)
    return reaction, braking, reaction + braking + margin, d - reaction - braking - margin

cells.code:
stages_ms = [80, 40, 60, 20, 100]
delay = sum(stages_ms) / 1000
print("delay_s", delay)
print("main_reaction_braking_required_reserve", budget(20, delay, 5, 50))
assert math.isclose(delay, 0.3)
assert budget(20, delay, 5, 50) == (6.0, 40.0, 48.0, 2.0)

for v, tau in [(20, 0.6), (10, 0.6), (0, 1.0), (20, 0.4)]:
    print("case", v, tau, budget(v, tau, 5, 50))
max_delay = (50 - 2 - 20**2 / (2*5)) / 20
print("max_delay_s", max_delay)
assert math.isclose(max_delay, 0.4)

notebooks.title: 核查消息门禁与习题数值
notebooks.setupCode:
import math
def gate(now, observed, valid, max_age=0.25):
    age = now - observed
    return "accept" if valid and 0 <= age <= max_age else "request_fallback"

cells.code:
cases = [(10, 9.8, True), (10, 9.75, True), (10, 9.6, True), (10, 10.1, True), (10, 9.8, False)]
decisions = [gate(*item) for item in cases]
print("gate_decisions", decisions)
assert decisions == ["accept", "accept", "request_fallback", "request_fallback", "request_fallback"]

v, b, d, margin = 20, 5, 50, 2
tau_limit = (d - margin - v*v/(2*b)) / v
ages = [10-9.8, 10-9.6, 10-10.1]
print("exercise_delay_limit_s", round(tau_limit, 6))
print("exercise_ages_s", [round(a, 6) for a in ages])
print("stationary_required_m", margin)
assert math.isclose(tau_limit, 0.4)
assert all(math.isclose(a, expected) for a, expected in zip(ages, [0.2, 0.4, -0.1]))
